description: An HTML source for a web-based database viewer application, providing UI components, styling, and client-side scripts to browse databases, tables, and view data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database's tables list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands/collapses cell content for full view.
